data.domestic: openfootball FR1, EN1, ES1, DE1, IT1 2018-19..2025-26
data.ucl: API-Football league 2, seasons 2018..2025, qualifiers included, 90-minute score (score.fulltime)

protocol: weekly refit (once per UCL week), 3-year window, with_uncertainty=False; baseline = home/draw/away frequencies of earlier UCL matches in the window

calibration.method: dc.RateCalibration on expected goals: gap log(lam/mu) -> stretch * gap, goal level kept; fitted by maximum 1X2 likelihood on earlier seasons' predictions only (expanding window from 2019-20), applied to the next season

historical_odds: API-Football /odds returned 0 results for past UCL fixtures (fixture=1199389, league=2 season=2023): no historical closing odds, so no profitability measure.
